# LDA commit message template
#
# Every commit MUST end with a Signed-off-by line (DCO 1.1 gate):
#   git commit -s        # auto-adds it from your git user.name / user.email
#
# Subject: one line, [GFI]/[fix]/[feat] prefix, <= 72 chars
#
# Body: what + why; tie to a red line / anchor count.
#
# Signed-off-by: Your Real Name <you@example.com>
